Name: Sebastian Portraits by noetinyy
Author: noetinyy
Description:
I'm currently working on the rest of the base game NPCs, I plan on making ones for SVE and Ridgeside as well <3 PLEASE NOTE: this requires Portraiture! As things stand right now, the winter sheet and the summer/island sheet will not work. When portraiture gets its official 1.6 update it SHOULD work then. If you have the skill set to make the other sheets work you have my full permission to do so! I just ask to be credited for the art. When HD portraits updates to 1.6 I'll try to make a compatible version for that as well!

Thank you for downloading, if you run into any issues please let me know <3
